phase3_findings.description: Widget render test checks only 5 of 8 row-rule kinds (not any_of, owner_via, referenced_by or its link) and no rendered source values; loading/empty/error/narrow states have no behavior test.
Assertion that two configs built back to back have different loaded_at timestamps depends on clock resolution and can fail spuriously.
No test covers Config.loaded_at raising RuntimeError for a never-validated config and get_access_rules returning it as isError.
LoadedRuleSets.sha256 defaults to an empty string, not a valid SHA-256; correctness relies on the single caller load_rule_sets.
_loaded_at is set once in the after-validator; Config is not frozen, so reassigning rule_sets or rls later changes the listing without changing the load time.
typed_value raises TypeError for an unsupported type and the get_access_rules handler catches only RuntimeError; unreachable with today's strict field types.
Doc says the widget has 'a name search', but the search also matches rule-set scope and table names and filters flat RLS rules by table. Capped by the behavior-inert prose cap (all three limbs held).
The .catch after app.connect() also catches render errors and callTool rejections from load(), labelling all of them 'Failed to connect to host'; the underlying message is still shown.
